releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v8.3.0 Highlights:
• Scrollable Update Dialog: Replaced fixed-height dialog with a resizable, scrollable patch notes dialog so the Update and Cancel buttons are always fully visible.
• Automated Low-Level Game-Focus Mode (Zero-Kill Background Governor).
• Non-Intrusive UXTU / Undervolt & PPT Safeguard.
• Zero-Dependency Native Single-Binary Architecture (<15 MB RAM).
• OEM Bloatware & Telemetry Neutralizer (Frees 500MB+ RAM).
• DirectX 11/12 Driver Pipeline Command List Multi-Threading Optimizer.
• SMT Core Parking on Battery (CPMINCORES 50, -18% Package Power).
• Micro-Thread Priority Gating for Anti-Cheat & DRM.
• Direct DWM Composition Bypass (Hardware Flip Model, Queue Size = 1).
• Dynamic Power Budget Ratio Optimizer (85W Max TGP Shift).
• Resolution Scale & FSR/NIS Automator.
• Kernel DPC Latency Watchdog & audiodg.exe Pro-Audio Lock.
